title: PreDraftReport
description: An AI-generated pre-draft radiology report, submitted by a partnerInitiated tool implementing the preDraftReportGeneration capability. Carried as the 'draftReport' member of a submission and referenced from a manifest as 'application/vnd.ms-dragon.rad.pre-draft-report+json'.

identifier.description: Partner-generated identifier for this result. Must be unique per run: resubmitting a stored identifier is rejected with 409 Conflict, so retrying a run cannot create a second stored result.

imagingStudyPriors.description: Prior studies used to generate the draft report.

AISystemInfo.description: The AI system that generated this draft report.

version.description: Partner's AI system version, semantic major.minor.patch.

ImagingStudy.description: The imaging study the draft report was generated from.

accessionNumber.description: Accession number of the study. This is what the result is matched to an order by, so it must match exactly one order in the environment: no match is rejected with 404 Not Found and more than one with 409 Conflict, rather than being stored against a guess.

patientMrn.description: Patient medical record number. Contains PHI.

procedureCode.description: CPT/HCPCS code for the procedure performed.

studyDateTime.description: Study date and time as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).

Series.description: A DICOM series the AI model read.

instanceUids.description: DICOM SOP Instance UIDs used by the AI model.

ImagingStudyPrior.description: A prior study used to generate the draft report.

studyUid.description: DICOM Study Instance UID of the prior study.

studyDateTime.description: Prior study date and time as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

modality.description: DICOM modality code for the prior study.

format.description: Content format. Only structured_report is accepted today.

StructuredReport.description: A structured report made up of named sections.

Section.description: A single named section of the report.

content.description: Section text, encoded per the parent structuredReport.format.

aiGenerated.description: Whether this section was generated by AI.

sectionOrder.description: Display order of this section within the report.

codes.description: Medical codes referenced in this section.

Code.description: A coded reference within a section.

system.description: Coding system the code belongs to.

code.description: The code within the coding system.

display.description: Human-readable display text for the code.

QualityMetrics.description: Quality scores for the generated report. Optional as a whole, but imageQualityScore is required when present.

overallConfidenceScore.description: Overall confidence for the whole report.
